Short title and commencement

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan
Foundation Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Definiton

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
2. Definition.‑‑In
this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires‑‑
(a) "Board" means the
Board of Governors of the Foundation;
(b) "Foundation" means
the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation;
(c) "Government" means
the Government of the Punjab;
(d) "Official member"
means a person holding a post under the Government; and
(e) "Trust" means the
Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Trust registered under the Societies
Registration Act XXI of 1860.

Establishment of the Foundation

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
3. Establishment of the
Foundation.‑‑(1) The Government may by notification establish a
Foundation to be called the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation.
(2) The Foundation shall be a
body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal with power to
acquire, hold and dispose of property and shall by the said name sue and be
sued.

Board of Governors

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
4. Board of Governors.‑‑(1)
The management of the affairs of the Foundation shall vest in a Board of
Governors consisting of such number of members as the Government may determine.
(2) The Government shall appoint
one of the members of the Board as the Chairman of the Board.
(3) Except for official members,
a person appointed to the Board shall be a person of eminence in his field.
(4) The term of office of a
member, other than an official member, shall be two years but the Government
may remove a member before the expiry of his term on the ground of misconduct
or ineptitude or mental or physical incapacitation.
(5) The term of office of an
official member shall be such as may be determined by the Government.

Secretary

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
5. Secretary.‑‑(1)
There shall be a Secretary of the Foundation.
(2) The Secretary shall be
appointed by the Government which shall also determine the terms and conditions
of his appointment.
(3) The Secretary shall be a
Member of the Board and Chief Executive of the Foundation and shall be
responsible to the Board for carrying out the objectives of the Foundation.

Powers and Function

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
6. Powers and Functions.‑‑(1)
Subject to the provisions of this Ordinance, and any Rules framed thereunder,
the Foundation may exercise such powers and take such measures as may be
necessary for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.
(2) Without prejudice to the
generality of the foregoing subsection, the Foundation shall:
(i) propagate and project the
ideology of Pakistan;
(ii) preserve the spirit and
memory of the Pakistan Movement;
(iii) trace, record and honour
the contributions and sacrifices made for the establishment of Pakistan;
(iv) contribute to the endeavours
to establish in Pakistan the promised social order based on Islam;
(v) promote national unity and fight
against all forms of disunity and exploitation; and
(vi) work as a national,
autonomous, ideological and democratic body to promote the aims and objects set
out in the Objectives Resolution as enshrined in the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973.

Foundation Fund

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
7. Foundation Fund.‑‑There
shall be a fund to be known as the Nazaria -e‑Pakistan Foundation Fund
which shall be vested in the Foundation and to which shall be credited all sums
received by the Foundation.

Source of Funds

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
8. Source of Funds.‑‑The
Funds of the Foundation shall be derived from the following sources:‑‑
(i) All monies, rights,
properties and assets standing in the name of the Trust
(ii) Grants of the Federal
Government and the Provincial Governments
(iii) Contributions and donations
from any source
(iv) Such other sources as may be
determined by the Government

Budget, Audit and Account

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
9. Budget, Audit and Account.‑‑The
budget of the Foundation shall be approved and its accounts shall be maintained
and audited in such manner as may be prescribed.

Officers, Advisers, etc.

NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
10. Officers, advisers, etc.‑The
Foundation may appoint such officers advisers, experts, consultants and
employees as it considers necessary for the efficient performance of its
functions on such terms and conditions as it may deem fit.

Rules

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
11. Rules.‑‑The
Government may make rules for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.

Regulations

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
12. Regulations.‑‑The
Foundation may by notification make regulations, not inconsistent with the
provisions of the rules, for the administration and management of the affairs of
the Foundation.

Dissolution of Nazaria-e-Pakistan Trust

NAZARIA﷓E﷓PAKISTAN FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
NAZARIA‑E‑PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to provide for the
establishment of the Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan Foundation
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 5th June, 1997]
No.Legis.3(XXIII)/97, dated 5‑6‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑
13. Dissolution of Nazaria‑e‑Pakistan
Trust.‑‑On the establishment of the Foundation, the Trust shall
stand dissolved and all its powers, rights, properties and assets shall vest
in, and its liabilities shall be the liabilities of, the Foundation.
